summary: Structured Obligations Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a routine distribution on the Select Notes Trust LT 2003-5 Long Term Certificates Series 2003-5, relating to the May 15, 2026 Interest Distribution Date. The filing includes a trustee's report detailing interest received ($110.625 per certificate), per-certificate income for Form 1099 ($3.058474), and disclaimers regarding the underlying issuers' SEC reporting. There are no transaction terms, merger activity, or strategic changes. This is a standard periodic disclosure for an asset-backed security trust, not a special situation. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
